item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Eternity / Jade Valerie / Sweetbox
item.description:
Hi everyone,

I'm trying to compile a Jade Valerie / Sweetbox discography and have some CDs on the way right now, but I was unable to find copies of the side project Eternity (2009) and the solo album Bittersweet Symphony (2008).

I was wondering if anyone had lossless or iTunes rips of these as I already have mp3 copies. Discogs links below, any edition is fine (especially for Eternity since it's so rare):

https://www.discogs.com/master/279858-Eternity-Eternity
iTunes Japan link if anyone has access to it: https://music.apple.com/jp/album/eternity/317301147

https://www.discogs.com/master/1501246-Jade-Valerie-Bittersweet-Symphony

Thank you!
